title: The learned net2 on net1 v7 with its u lowered by net1's capacity spread where it believes copies
description: exp-spread-head-v7-val-288: adding K relu(spread - 0.15) (1 - p) to the learned net2's u, p its belief in a stock TCP flow, gained among copies (+0.021 and +0.147 against -0.092 for K = -0.4 and -0.8) but lost beside a Cubic flow that started first (-0.050 and -0.129 against +0.011) and on the five-family mean (+0.133 and +0.104 against +0.148): p did not keep the window beside a buffer-filler. This scales the same term by q, the student's belief in copies, which is trained on copies labels (actors.SpreadHead gate "copies", experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py --spread K --spread-gate copies), K = -0.8 (net2-v7-q8-sN) and -1.6 (net2-v7-q16-sN), on each learned net2 on net1 v7 (round 29, iteration 39, seeds 1 to 3, model-truth-patch-src), plain beside them (net2-v7-sN), and the fixed rule (rule-u0.25). Question, stated before the run: does the spread lower the window among copies, where it helps, without lowering it beside a buffer-filler? Criterion: a K beats the plain net2 by at least 0.01 on the five-family mean over the three seeds and gains among copies. Validation links at campaign seed 21 and 2 and 4 copies. If it passes, K is confirmed at campaign seeds 11 and 31 before any test run.
prepare: (cd "$IN/t" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/r" "$IN/t/net1-v7.pt" --u 0.25; P=(--policy "rule-u0.25=$OUT/r/rule-u0.25.onnx"); declare -A K=([q8]=-0.8 [q16]=-1.6); for s in s1 s2 s3; do d="$OUT/runs/r29-$s"; mkdir -p "$d"; cp "$IN/t/net1-v7.pt" "$d/net1.pt"; cp "$IN/t/r29-$s.actor.pt" "$d/actor.pt"; cp "$IN/t/r29-$s.ppo_spec.json" "$d/ppo_spec.json"; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-v7-$s" "$d" --t 0.5; P+=(--policy "net2-v7-$s=$OUT/p/net2-v7-$s.onnx"); for k in q8 q16; do uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-v7-$k-$s" "$d" --t 0.5 --spread "${K[$k]}" --s0 0.15 --spread-gate copies; P+=(--policy "net2-v7-$k-$s=$OUT/p/net2-v7-$k-$s.onnx"); done; done; [ "${#P[@]}" -eq 20 ]; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 21 21 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 21 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart copies-30s && for s in s1 s2 s3; do uv run python experiments/versus_rule.py "$OUT" "net2-v7-$s"; done
